tier-rule.value: An uncut gem of level N engraves a skill of tier N or lower, at gem level N

skill-tiers.note: skill gem tiers; tier 0 is not cuttable (PoB's Tier counts)

support-sockets.tree-granted.note: an estimate (D-359): the most supports a skill granted by a passive (the tree or the ascendancy) holds, keyed by character level. 3 below level 40: Act 2 (area levels 16 to 31) into Act 3; 4 from level 40: Act 3's second half (to 45), Act 4 (46 to 53) and the interludes; 5 from level 60: the campaign's end (the interludes start at 54 to 56 and rise about 8). Area levels from campaign/areas.json. An item-granted skill's supports follow its item's sockets, and a gem's its own
